result.title: OBB-PBD: Extending Parallel Box Decoding to Oriented Bounding Boxes for Referring Expression Grounding in Aerial Imagery
result.comment: Published in Remote Sensing 18(20), 3535 (2026). Code and checkpoints: https://github.com/ce-dric/OBB-PBD and https://huggingface.co/ce-dric/OBB-PBD
result.summary: Referring expression grounding in overhead imagery requires oriented bounding boxes rather than horizontal ones, since aerial objects appear at arbitrary orientations. Most grounding models emit box coordinates sequentially; Parallel Box Decoding (PBD) instead predicts all geometry slots in one forward pass, but only for four-coordinate horizontal boxes. We extend this block-aligned interface to a six-slot oriented representation using a double-angle parameterization. Rather than assuming correctness from a decreasing loss curve, we verify the extension with image/prompt-shuffle controls and visibility/leakage probes, which show that the corrected model depends on both the image and the prompt rather than on prompt statistics alone. On the aerial vehicle visual grounding (AVVG) benchmark, whose targets are genuinely oriented, the extended model improves rotated intersection over union (rotIoU) from 0.1253 for the zero-shot baseline to 0.303 +/- 0.012 (mean +/- standard deviation over three training seeds) across the complete 6139-record test split spanning all 120 images. Learning oriented boxes rather than their axis-aligned envelopes adds 0.055 +/- 0.008 rotIoU beyond a matched control (per-seed 95% confidence intervals all excluding zero), whereas block expansion alone yields no rotIoU gain distinguishable from zero.

AI.brief_summary: 将 Parallel Box Decoding 从四坐标水平框扩展为六槽有向框（双角度参数化），用于航拍图像中的指代表达定位，并用图像/提示打乱及可见性、泄漏探针验证模型依赖图像与提示，在 AVVG 上提升 rotIoU。
AI.relevance_reason: 「一次前向并行填满全部几何槽」的接口设计与图像/提示打乱、泄漏探针可供核查：前者可能类比并行而非自回归地产生结构化状态，后者可作为检查 VLM 是否真正使用视觉证据而非提示统计的诊断手段；但论文本身不涉及 latent 推理状态，与主线距离较远。
